'''Trohlu''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]], a terrestrial world in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Without an atmosphere, the yellow rocks of the moon did not support life. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established an observation post on the moon, in addition to a listening station.
